title: ⚠️ A Dangerous Flaw Shakes the Programming World!
body: ⚠️ A Dangerous Flaw Shakes the Programming World!
A security researcher discovered a critical vulnerability in the Java language, called Java4Shell, with a severity score of 9.2 out of 10.
The flaw lets an attacker run malicious commands remotely in popular software such as Jira, Confluence, and Jenkins, and exploitation attempts have already begun.
Remarkably, the researcher found it with the help of AI in just one hour, at a cost of under $200.
Oracle has already released the patch, so update your software now.
Do you update your software as soon as patches come out? Or do you wait?
